title: Ten Layers Down
tagline: ten locks, one tape, one old betrayal

client.intro.a.speaker: client
text: It is Silas, Owl, I need the ivory case from the vault below.

client.intro.b.speaker: client
text: The job is simple, grab it and do not look inside it for anyone.

client.intro.c.speaker: client
text: I am warning you, leave the lining alone if you want to live.

client.intro.repeat.speaker: client
text: Same building. Same job. Bring me the ivory deposit case, Owl.

marlow.intro.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am in the foyer, I smell polish and hear a clock ticking ahead.

marlow.story.limp.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I hear rubber soles squeaking, that is the same sound from the night you lost your sight.

marlow.twist.tape.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I found a tape sewn in the lining, I can hear Silas on it.

client.got.speaker: client
text: You got it, good, do not open anything else, just get out fast.

client.checkin.speaker: client
text: Owl, talk to me, where is she, is she out of the vault yet.

marlow.outro.win.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am out on the street, I can hear the traffic and I am breathing again.

client.tape.speaker: client
text: If Owl keeps talking, leave him blind, make it look like an accident.

marlow.epilogue.ask.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, it is Silas ordering it, what do I do with this tape? Burn it, or send it?

marlow.epilogue.burn.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I am holding the tape to my lighter now, it curls and it is gone.

marlow.epilogue.send.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I slipped the tape into the mail slot, it is gone to the papers.

client.after.burn.speaker: client
text: Good, Owl, that tape never existed and we are clean, you hear me.

client.after.send.speaker: client
text: You fool, Owl, you have ruined me, they will come for me now.

marlow.nudge.office.speaker: marlow
text: The ivory deposit case is in the deep vault, boss. Want me to head there?

marlow.nudge.take.speaker: marlow
text: It's right here, boss. Want me to take the ivory deposit case?

marlow.nudge.exit.speaker: marlow
text: We have it. Back to the fizz foyer and out, boss.

guide.brief.job.speaker: guide
text: The job. Ten Layers Down. ten locks, one tape, one old betrayal. You are Owl, a blind fixer. Marlow is your eyes. Your client is Silas. The place belongs to Petra.

guide.brief.cast.speaker: guide
text: The players. Owl: the voice in her ear. That is you. Marlow: the eyes. Silas: the client. Harlan: the night guard. Petra: owns the place.

guide.card.speaker: guide
text: Ten Layers Down. ten locks, one tape, one old betrayal. Press Enter to play it.

marlow.story.hall.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see a wide hall with clocks ticking, I hear the guard squeaking far off and smell old rubbish.

marlow.story.office.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see a rented trader desk with cold coffee, I hear papers rustling and smell stale sandwiches.

marlow.story.vault.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see rows of small boxes two floors down, I hear heat wires humming and smell oil.

marlow.story.gallery.speaker: marlow
text: Boss, I see a gallery with gem posters, I hear rain on glass and smell polish.

marlow.lore.client.0.speaker: marlow
text: Silas is the client, boss. He was your partner once before he sold you out.

marlow.lore.guard.0.speaker: marlow
text: Harlan lost his brother in the docks, boss. He takes night work to stay quiet.

marlow.lore.guard.1.speaker: marlow
text: Harlan is the night guard, boss. He owes Silas money and walks soft to pay it off.

marlow.lore.owner.0.speaker: marlow
text: Petra is the owner, boss. She runs the Meridian Exchange and trusts her vault downstairs.

marlow.lore.item.0.speaker: marlow
text: The deposit case has ten layers of locks, boss. Heat wires and magnets guard the vault door.

marlow.lore.item.1.speaker: marlow
text: The deposit case is the job, boss. Silas rented an office here for two years to learn it.

marlow.lore.history.0.speaker: marlow
text: This game is inspired by the 2003 weekend vault robbery where thieves emptied safe boxes below a gem exchange.

marlow.lore.marlow.0.speaker: marlow
text: I'm Marlow, boss. Your eyes.
